scope: Device identification cards only. No operational commissioning, wiring or interoperability guarantee is inferred from shared appearance.
image_processing: Original manufacturer pixels; alpha flattened onto white, maximum 1200 px, WebP quality 93. PDF illustrations extracted by exact image XRef from inspected page 1. No generated imagery.

devices.document_title: PP5099 REACH Wireless User Manual FW1.0.3 R1
devices.model_evidence: White REACH interface enclosure with lower status indicators. Its display and navigation controls are inside the cover.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: REACH interface, not XPander. Linked PP5099 is revision 1 for firmware 1.0.3; match the actual firmware before following menu instructions.

devices.model_evidence: Small round white remote indicator with a central red LED behind the fire symbol. This is an indicator, not a detector.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: The MiniDisc indicates a connected detector’s status. Applicable terminals and electrical limits depend on the connected device and the MiniDisc instructions.

devices.document_title: 39215-002 Intelligent Auto-Aligning Beam Detector User Guide
devices.model_evidence: Manufacturer picture shows the beam head, separate controller and reflector together. Identify the SA7100-100APO set on its label.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: Auto-aligning intelligent model, not an assumed match for other Apollo beam products. The controller/head/reflector arrangement and permitted setup come from its own user guide.

devices.model_evidence: White base-mounted flame detector with a dark circular sensing window. Three infrared sensing channels sit behind that window.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: Base-mounted IR3 version. The linked PP2331 Issue 9 expressly excludes the 45681-321 isolator base. Confirm the code and approved base; UV/IR2 and other housings are different products.

devices.model_evidence: Cream XPander enclosure with front power, fault and wireless-activity indicators. Check the full interface code.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: XPander device family only; Apollo states it is not CoreProtocol compatible. It is distinct from the REACH wireless interface and requires supported panel configuration.

devices.model_evidence: White TimeSaver base with grouped screw terminals, shown without a head. The diode model shares the standard base’s exterior.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: Diode variant for the specified active end-of-line head-removal monitoring arrangement. Confirm the base label and system design; photo and shared wiring guide do not identify every TimeSaver variant.

review_notes: Six genuinely new device families; no existing Apollo cards modified.
Exact manufacturer product pages directly link the archive manuals used. Manual edition applicability is stated where material, especially REACH firmware 1.0.3.

The Orbis diode-base product page reuses a TimeSaver family image and its metadata has an unrelated caption. The visible image is a base, matches the guide design, and card explicitly requires the diode model label.
XPander is explicitly excluded from CoreProtocol; no REACH/XPander radio interoperability is claimed.
Catalogue records were PDF-indexed without hashes. Actual downloaded document hashes, page counts and reviewed pages are recorded here.
visual_review: Each final card image was inspected on the per-brand contact sheet and compared with its source product page or manufacturer PDF illustration. Shared housing, assembled-head/base and edition limitations were retained.
